title: DeepSpeed 0.19.8 AutoEP universal conversion loads expert shards with weights_only=False

root_cause.note: The AutoEP universal converter walks layer_<n>_expert_<e>_mp_rank_*.pt files in an attacker-writable checkpoint directory and loads each one with weights_only=False. The new file landed in v0.19.8 (2026-10-20). A malicious expert shard executes during ds_to_universal conversion, before the expected-key check.

preconditions: attacker can write an AutoEP checkpoint directory (shared NFS/PVC, poisoned peer rank, or model mirror)
victim runs DeepSpeed universal checkpoint conversion on that directory
steps: add the pinned v0.19.8 source tree to sys.path and import the real autoep_universal module
call consolidate_autoep_expert_files and observe the marker before the expected-key error
expected_evidence: log with source hash, sink line 459, and the post-sink error
cleanup: temp checkpoint/output dirs under evidence/ are rewritten per run
notes: Imports the real v0.19.8 autoep_universal module (vendored source tree, empty package __init__ only) and uses the real installed torch 2.14 CPU build. No CUDA is required for this conversion path.
